cards.intuition: Query and document are read together in one sequence, so the model scores the pair, not either side alone.
Because the encoding depends on the specific pair, nothing document-side can be baked before the query arrives.
The query conditions how each document token is read, so negation, units, and disambiguation are resolved in context.
A 512-token window can cut away the decisive span; retrieve focused chunks so the evidence survives inside it.

cards.intuition: Encode each document once offline, index the vectors, then pay one query encoding plus a fast index search online.
